This is NOT read-only: execute existing prepare_event/transition.prepare and Condition.check in actual candidate/condition order using EventData and send_event args. Report condition index/target/pass/fail/skipped/error type; failure skips remaining conditions then tries next candidate, success skips later candidates, errors stop without exception message. Investigate the real source, explain the call path and clarify the business requirements before obtaining plan approval and implementing. Deliver real engineering changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. Repair independently reported failures; questions, answers and documentation do not count as separate completed objectives.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual business behavior and the frozen scope; do not grade by matching the reference patch text.
